prediction.likelyOutcome: EQY should recover the great majority of the $170,484.37 past-due-rent claim against Williamson and Gore jointly and severally, since liability is effectively unopposed and the fight is confined to two bounded, contractually-disfavored offset theories that Williamson has thin evidentiary support for. Expect a judgment in the roughly $140,000-$165,000 range on the rent claim alone, before any attorney's fee award (which cannot be quantified on this record but should be recoverable if properly proven).

issues.label: Mitigation Offset — Free Rent to Replacement Tenant (Williamson claims $62,096.52 credit)

outcome.description: After a bench trial the court awarded the landlord $170,484.37 in past-due rent, the full amount it sought, with no credit for the $62,096.52 free-rent overlap offset or the $20,000 personal property. It also awarded $86,725.00 in attorney's fees. On appeal the rent damages were affirmed and the fee award reversed.
outcome.finalNote: Rent damages affirmed; fee award reversed.
